title: Sales Representative
description:
**Company Description** 
 The dr Shep Pvt Ltd is a pharmaceutical manufacturing company specializing in high\-quality IV fluids and infusion solutions for healthcare institutions across India. Its portfolio includes essential formulations such as Normal Saline (NS), Dextrose Normal Saline (DNS), Ringer Lactate (RL), Dextrose 5% (D5\), and Dextrose 10% (D10\), serving hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, distributors, and procurement organizations. The company operates with a strong commitment to quality, consistency, safety, and reliable supply, supported by controlled processes and disciplined pharmaceutical practices. In addition to manufacturing, the dr Shep is building a robust distribution network to improve accessibility of IV solutions and foster long\-term partnerships with healthcare buyers. The company’s vision is to be a trusted pharmaceutical partner through strong quality systems, efficient supply networks, and customer\-focused relationships.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Sales Representative role based in Pimpri Chinchwad. The Sales Representative will promote the company’s IV fluid and infusion products to hospitals, clinics, nursing homes, distributors, and other healthcare institutions in the assigned territory. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include identifying and meeting prospective clients, conducting product presentations, explaining product features and benefits, and maintaining strong relationships with existing customers. The role involves regular field visits, follow\-ups on inquiries, negotiating orders within company guidelines, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction. The Sales Representative will also monitor market trends, gather competitor and customer feedback, maintain accurate sales records, and achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Proven sales skills in healthcare or pharmaceutical products, including territory management and client relationship\-building.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation abilities to engage with medical and procurement professionals.
* Basic product and technical understanding of IV fluids, infusion solutions, or related pharmaceutical formulations (training can be provided).
* Ability to plan daily field activities, manage time effectively, and maintain detailed sales and visit documentation.
* Comfort with using phones, email, and basic digital tools or CRM systems for follow\-up and reporting.
* Minimum qualification: Bachelor’s degree or diploma in science, pharmacy, business, or a related field (relevant experience may be considered).
* Prior experience as a medical representative or pharmaceutical sales professional is an advantage.
* Willingness to travel within Pimpri Chinchwad and nearby areas and work in an on\-site, field\-oriented environment.

title: Client Relationship Manager – Mutual Funds & Investments
description:
About Mangalmurti Investments
 
 Mangalmurti Investments is a
 **third\-generation financial services business established in 1982 in Dombivli** 
 . We work with individuals and families to address their investment and financial product requirements across mutual funds and other financial products.
 



 We are a relationship\-driven business with a strong focus on
 **long\-term client relationships, personalised service and trust** 
 .
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a
 **Client Relationship Manager** 
 to join our team at our Dombivli office.
 



 The role involves
 **managing and nurturing relationships with existing and prospective clients** 
 , understanding their financial goals and requirements, and helping them identify suitable mutual fund and investment products.
 



 The position is highly client\-facing and involves regular interaction with clients, conducting meetings, explaining investment products and their risk profiles, coordinating transactions and documentation, and ensuring timely follow\-ups and portfolio reviews.
 



 The role will also involve identifying new business opportunities, supporting client acquisition and marketing initiatives, and contributing to overall
 **client satisfaction, relationship growth and retention** 
 .
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Manage and nurture relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Understand clients' financial goals, requirements and investment preferences.
* Conduct client meetings and explain mutual funds and other investment products in a simple and clear manner.
* Explain product features, associated risks and relevant considerations to clients.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups and portfolio reviews.
* Handle client onboarding, documentation and service\-related requirements.
* Coordinate with internal teams, AMCs, platforms and other stakeholders for timely processing of transactions and service requests.
* Resolve client queries and ensure a high level of client satisfaction.
* Maintain accurate client records, documentation and follow\-up schedules in accordance with applicable processes and regulatory requirements.
* Identify relevant opportunities for
 **new business and relationship expansion** 
 based on client requirements.
* Support business development and marketing initiatives.
* Stay updated on mutual funds, financial products, market developments and relevant processes.
* Contribute towards building
 **long\-term client relationships and client retention** 
 .


 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who is
 **confident interacting with clients, genuinely interested in investments and eager to learn and grow with the organisation.** 




**The ideal candidate should have:** 



* Strong client service and relationship management skills, with the ability to understand client needs and communicate solutions clearly.
* Knowledge of
 **mutual funds, capital markets and basic investment principles** 
 .
* Familiarity with insurance and other financial products will be an advantage.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts clearly and patiently.
* Ability and willingness to participate in
 **sales and business development activities** 
 , including prospecting, presenting investment options and converting opportunities ethically.
* Good organisational and administrative skills, including handling documentation, maintaining records and working accurately with data.
* Comfort with computers, investment platforms and common office software such as spreadsheets and CRM/client\-tracking tools.
* Ability to manage multiple client interactions and follow\-ups while maintaining attention to detail.
* Professionalism, accountability and a strong service orientation.
* Willingness to continuously learn about investments and financial products.
* A genuine interest in building a
 **long\-term career with us** 
 .


 Experience
 
 Prior experience in
 **mutual funds, wealth management, banking, insurance, broking or other financial services** 
 will be preferred.
 



 Candidates with strong client\-facing experience and a genuine interest in learning about investments may also be considered.
 


 Education \& Certifications
 * Bachelor's degree in
 **Finance, Commerce, Business or a related field** 
 preferred.
* **NISM / AMFI\-related certifications** 
 will be an advantage.
* Relevant experience and demonstrated client\-handling ability will also be considered.


 Location \& Compensation
 
**Location:** 
 Dombivli, Maharashtra
 



**Work mode:** 
 Full\-time, On\-site
 



**Compensation:** 
  ₹3 LPA in\-hand
 


 Why Join Us?
 
 This is an opportunity to work with an
 **established, third\-generation financial services business** 
 and gain hands\-on exposure to mutual funds, investments, client relationship management and wealth management.
 


* We are particularly interested in candidates who are looking for a
 **stable, long\-term opportunity** 
 and want to develop their career while growing with the organisation.

title: Manager Technical Sales Support Local
description:
* Major Responsibilities
* Develop and execute a PAN India service growth strategy for the Commercial Building Services (CBS) and Wastewater (WWW) segments.
* Drive the development, expansion, and capability enhancement of Authorized Service Centers (ASCs) across India to ensure effective service coverage and customer support.
* Achieve and exceed annual spare parts order intake, revenue, and profitability targets through strategic planning, channel development, and increased aftermarket penetration.
* Establish, monitor, and improve key service performance indicators (KPIs) including spare parts order intake, response time, First Time Fix Rate (FTFR), customer satisfaction, complaint resolution, and ASC performance.
* Develop and implement ASC business growth plans, performance scorecards, and service excellence programs to enhance operational effectiveness.
* Mentor, coach, and develop ASC engineers and service teams across India to improve technical competency, service quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Conduct customer awareness seminars, technical workshops, and maintenance programs to promote lifecycle service offerings, preventive maintenance practices, and spare parts business growth.
* Enhance customer satisfaction and retention through proactive service engagement, technical reviews, structured complaint management, and periodic service audits.
* Conduct customer satisfaction surveys and ensure implementation of corrective and preventive actions to continuously improve service quality.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer complaints through effective coordination with ASCs, Branch Offices, Warranty Teams, Product Support, and Plant functions.
* Prepare and maintain spare parts pricing strategies while ensuring compliance with management guidelines and profitability objectives.
* Drive spare parts profitability through improved parts penetration, optimized inventory management, and effective spare stocking strategies at ASCs and Central Warehouse (CWH).
* Provide technical guidance to ASC engineers for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, root cause analysis (RCA), and corrective actions.
* Gather field product performance feedback and collaborate with Product Management, QA, Manufacturing, and Engineering teams to support continuous product improvement initiatives.
* Deliver product and service training programs for customers, ASCs, dealers, service partners, and KSB coordinators.
* Coordinate with Central Warehouse, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders to ensure timely availability and delivery of spare parts.
* Lead digital transformation initiatives, including AI\-enabled analytics, service dashboards, predictive maintenance solutions, mobile service applications, and process automation to enhance business efficiency and customer experience.
* Utilize data analytics to identify spare consumption trends, service opportunities, and ASC performance improvement areas.
* Drive preventive maintenance, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC), retrofit, modernization, and other service\-related business opportunities to expand aftermarket revenue streams.
* Minimize customer complaint resolution time through effective deployment of service resources, spare availability, and ASC support.


**B. Work Performed**
* Appoint new Authorized Service Centers (ASCs) as per defined business expansion targets and service coverage requirements.
* Develop and implement dedicated ASC policies for CBS and WWW segments.
* Prepare, maintain, and upload annual spare parts price lists for CBS and WWW segments.
* Conduct periodic ASC audits and develop action plans for capability enhancement and performance improvement.
* Monitor ASC spare parts inventory and establish optimum stocking levels to ensure prompt and reliable customer service support.
* Handle customer complaint escalations by coordinating with ASC Engineers, KSB coordinators, Warranty Teams, and other stakeholders. Visit customer sites, when required, to support root cause identification and resolution.
* Conduct product, application, and service training programs for ASC personnel, customers, dealers, and KSB teams.
* Lead digital transformation projects, including AI\-driven analytics, service dashboards, predictive maintenance initiatives, mobile service applications, and business process automation.
* Analyze service and spare parts data to identify consumption trends, business opportunities, and improvement actions.
* Define, monitor, and review ASC performance scorecards covering service quality, response time, spare parts business, inventory management, audit compliance, and customer feedback.
* Develop competency\-building, succession planning, and capability development programs for ASC engineers and service coordinators.
* Support the implementation of service excellence initiatives aimed at improving customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and profitability.


**C. Work Contacts**
 Internal
   

  

* Superiors and colleagues from Branch Offices (BOs), Zonal Offices (ZOs), and Service Teams.
* Departments including Product Management \& Support, Quality Assurance (QA), Production, Engineering, Marketing Services, Warranty, Central Warehouse, Supply Chain, and Sales.
* New Pump Business teams for coordinated customer support and business development activities.


 External
   

  

* Authorized Service Centers (ASCs).
* End Users and Key Customers.
* Suppliers, Contractors, and Service Partners.
* Consultants and Project Stakeholders, as applicable.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Collaborate closely with Product Management, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Warranty, Central Warehouse, Sales, and Marketing teams to improve product reliability, service effectiveness, and customer experience.
* Support new product introduction activities through service readiness planning, technical documentation, and training programs.


**D. Independence of Operation**
* Independently manage ASC development, performance monitoring, and service capability enhancement programs across assigned territories.
* Independently coordinate with ASC Engineers, Warranty Teams, Product Support, and Branch Offices to ensure timely customer complaint resolution.
* Develop and implement appropriate ASC spare stocking strategies to support service responsiveness and customer satisfaction.
* Recommend and execute corrective actions based on ASC audits, customer feedback, and service performance analysis.
* Drive service improvement and digital transformation initiatives within the framework of organizational policies and guidelines.


**E. Physical Effort**
* Significant field\-oriented role involving regular customer, ASC, and site visits across India.
* Collection and analysis of installation base data and identification of service coverage gaps ("white spots") in collaboration with BO and ZO teams for ASC appointments.
* Extensive interaction with customers, ASCs, and internal stakeholders to resolve technical and service\-related issues.
* Occasional working beyond normal business hours to meet customer commitments, project requirements, and business objectives.
* Frequent business travel involving regular movement outside office premises.


**F. Work Conditions**
* Combination of desk\-based and field\-based responsibilities.
* Extensive travel across India for ASC development, customer visits, audits, training programs, and service reviews.
* Dynamic work environment requiring interaction with customers, service partners, manufacturing locations, and cross\-functional teams.


 Requirement Profile
   

  

 Formal Education
   

  

 Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
   

  

 Professional Experience
   

  

 10\-12 years of experience in ASC Development, Service Operations, Aftermarket Business, or Customer Support functions within a reputed manufacturing organization.
   

  

 Exposure to pumps, HVAC systems, hydropneumatics systems, wastewater solutions, motors, VFDs, fire protection systems, and related electromechanical products is preferred.
   

  

 Experience in channel partner management, service business growth, customer relationship management, spare parts business, and aftermarket operations is essential.
   

  

 Defined Competencies
   

  

 Good knowledge of industrial safety standards, electrical safety requirements, and field service best practices.
   

  

**Technical Competencies**
* Hydraulic system fundamentals and pump application engineering.
* Pump installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and performance analysis.
* Knowledge of HVAC, hydropneumatics systems, wastewater solutions, motors, VFDs, and fire protection systems.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and failure analysis methodologies.
* Industrial, mechanical, and electrical safety standards.
* Service diagnostics, condition monitoring, and predictive maintenance concepts.
* Digital tools, service analytics, and AI\-enabled service applications.


**Functional Competencies**
* Service Business Management.
* Aftermarket Revenue Growth.
* ASC and Channel Partner Development.
* ASC \& Customer Relationship Management.
* Spare Parts and Inventory Management.
* Service Operations and Complaint Resolution.
* Data Analytics and Digital Transformation.
* Performance Monitoring.
* Training and Capability Development.


**Behavioural Competencies**
* Leadership and Team Development.
* Strategic Thinking.
* Customer Centricity.
* Decision Making.
* Problem Solving and Analytical Skills.
* Stakeholder Management.
* Communication and Presentation Skills.
* Collaboration and Influencing Skills.
* Result Orientation.
* Continuous Improvement Mindset.


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* ASC Development Target Achievement (%)
* Spare Parts Order Intake Growth (%)
* Spare Parts Revenue Achievement (%)
* Aftermarket Business Growth (%)
* Customer Complaint Resolution Time
* Customer Satisfaction Score
* ASC Audit Compliance Score
* Training Effectiveness and Coverage

title: Business Development Manager (PSS08091)
description:
**About The Company**
 Leading manufacturer of metallic flexible flow solutions, serving customers across India and in more than 90 countries worldwide. The company offers a comprehensive range of products, including stainless\-steel corrugated hoses, braided hoses, composite hoses, metal bellows, and expansion joints. Its solutions cater to a diverse range of industries, including Oil \& Gas, Chemical, Petrochemical, Power, Semiconductor, Pharmaceutical, HVAC, Aerospace, Defence, Marine, and Industrial Manufacturing.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The
 **Business Development Manager** 
 role in the Bellows and Expansion Joints Division exists to identify, develop, and expand business opportunities with OEMs across domestic and international markets. This position drives the establishment of relationships with global OEMs, generates qualified business opportunities, and ensures their seamless handover to the Sales team for commercial discussions and order closure. The role reports directly to Management.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Identify and develop new business opportunities with OEMs in India and international markets.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision\-makers including Engineering, Procurement, Design, and Project teams of global OEMs.
* Generate and qualify new business opportunities to create a robust sales pipeline for the Bellows and Expansion Joints division.
* Conduct customer meetings, technical presentations, and product demonstrations to promote the division’s offerings.
* Understand customer applications and recommend suitable products in coordination with Engineering and Technical teams.
* Collaborate closely with the Sales team to ensure seamless handover of qualified opportunities for quotation, negotiation, and order closure.
* Develop market entry strategies for new geographies and identify high\-potential OEM accounts globally.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and identify emerging industry trends and customer requirements.
* Represent the company at international trade fairs, exhibitions, and customer visits to strengthen global presence.
* Maintain CRM records, sales pipeline reports, customer visit reports, and document business development activities.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support new product introductions and customer qualification processes.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related Engineering discipline; MBA in Marketing is an advantage.
* Experience: 10\+ years in Business Development, OEM Sales, International Sales, or Technical Sales within engineering or industrial manufacturing.
* Leadership: Proven ability to develop business with global OEMs and manage cross\-functional collaboration; reports to Management.
* Technical Expertise: Knowledge of Metal Bellows, Expansion Joints, Flexible Hoses, Industrial Components, Valves, Pumps, Process Equipment; strong understanding of engineering drawings, industrial applications, and customer specifications.
* Soft Skills: Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills; adept at international customer engagement and cross\-cultural business communication.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India and internationally.


 Why Consider this Opportunity?
   

  

* Lead business development for a specialized division with global reach across diverse industrial sectors.
* Drive strategic market expansion and develop relationships with key global OEMs.
* Engage in high\-impact international sales and technical presentations, enhancing global brand presence.
* Collaborate across functions to influence product innovation and customer qualification.
* Operate within a growth\-oriented environment serving over 90 countries worldwide.

title: Director New Business Development

**5W1H is not just a name, but a formula to seek deeper answers. We use this methodology of 5W’s (Who, What, Why, When \& Where) and 1H (How) as a tool to Question Everything, challenge the status quo \& think outside the box to bring the vision into a reality.**

 Branding and Design

 ·

 Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills. Proven ability to create and execute business development strategies. Expertise in building and nurturing client relationships. Knowledge of advertising channels and marketing techniques.
 



 ·

 ·

 Proficiency in MS Office, especially PowerPoint, for effective client presentations.
 



 ·

 Hands\-on experience leading projects and collaborating with diverse teams to achieve ambitious growth targets.

**We are on a mission to bring India’s best creative and media minds all under one roof, to provide brands with awesome brand building experience like never before!**
